lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 9 distinct high-contrast vertical lines with relatively uniform spacing across the mid-torso, narrowing toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first anterior line terminates at the lower neck boundary; the eighth and ninth lines are abbreviated segments on the posterior haunch that do not extend to the ventral line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lateral surface of the right hindquarter.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the mid-haunch align vertically to form a semi-connected geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: White horizontal marking on the lower neck/chest; white facial markings on the snout bridge and below the eye; white patches on the inner limb surfaces.
